## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) while XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%); VXX falling (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION and rising consumer cycle confirm rotation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY. Fear retreating short-term: VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION; Stocks vs Bonds shows modest equity tilt with SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY vs TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength holding above trend: Dollar (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND while duration preference is in RECOVERY. Yield curve steepening modestly (Yield Curve 1W: +1.48% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY, leaving conditions mixed but not tightening sharply.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Growth/momentum showing short-term leadership: XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and Tech vs Financials rising; Financials also RECOVERY with Financials (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY. Energy mixed: XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) while Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) ABOVE TREND, so style: Growth-tilt but rotation within cyclicals.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities showing modest leadership: SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY and QQQ (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -4.10%) RECOVERY. EM/China mixed with EEM (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY, while Europe/Japan show relative improvement.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation mixed: IWM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY show risk-on flows, but IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND signals crypto/speculative weakness.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity rally concentrated in oil: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND; base metals mixed with CPER (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) RECOVERY. Gold and silver showing short-term catch-up: GLD (1W: +7.18% | 1M: -8.98%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +8.26% | 1M: -12.68%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy is bifurcated: oil spot ETFs strong (USO ABOVE TREND) while energy equities lag with XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%). Natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (9/11) and positive 1W in core equity ETFs SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY and QQQ (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -4.10%) RECOVERY. Divergence severity: MAJOR divergence across SPY, XLK, XLF and TLT (1W positive vs 1M negative) — treat the ROTATION as transitional and stay selective.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor sectors showing relative strength such as XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to crypto/bitcoin ETF IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND and watch XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION for volatility.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and Materials (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy equities XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND and industrial metals if CPER fails to sustain gains (CPER 1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) RECOVERY.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency pivot); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF ~2.0–2.5 (growth vs value posture); SPY reaction around recent 1W range (monitor for follow-through).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive confirming broad participation despite mixed 1M prints. XLK and materials showing strength while MAJOR divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT is the key risk to monitor.
